name: Hanuman Chalisa
source_note: Text cross-checked against Gita Press editions. Transliteration and English meaning are original.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
verses.transliteration:
Śrī Guru Carana Saroja Raja, Nija Manu Mukuru Sudhāri |
Baranauṃ Raghubara Bimala Jasu, Jo Dāyaku Phala Chāri ||
verses.meaning: After purifying the mirror of my mind with the dust from the lotus feet of my Guru, I describe the untainted glory of Lord Rama, who bestows the four fruits of life.

verses.devanagari:
बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौं पवनकुमार ।
बल बुद्धि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार ॥
verses.transliteration:
Buddhihīna Tanu Jānike, Sumirauṃ Pavanakumāra |
Bala Buddhi Bidyā Dehu Mohiṃ, Harahu Kalesa Bikāra ||
verses.meaning: Knowing myself to be ignorant, I invoke Hanuman, son of the Wind God. Grant me strength, wisdom, and knowledge, and remove all afflictions and impurities.

verses.devanagari:
जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर ।
जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jaya Hanumāna Jñāna Guna Sāgara |
Jaya Kapīsa Tihuṃ Loka Ujāgara ||
verses.meaning: Glory to Hanuman, ocean of knowledge and virtues. Glory to the king of monkeys, whose fame illumines the three worlds.

verses.devanagari:
राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा ।
अंजनि पुत्र पवनसुत नामा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Rāma Dūta Atulita Bala Dhāmā |
Añjani Putra Pavanasuta Nāmā ||
verses.meaning: You are the messenger of Lord Rama, the abode of incomparable strength, the son of Anjani, known by the name Pavanasuta.

verses.devanagari:
महाबीर बिक्रम बजरंगी ।
कुमति निवार सुमति के संगी ॥
verses.transliteration:
Mahābīra Bikrama Bajaraṅgī |
Kumati Nivāra Sumati Ke Saṅgī ||
verses.meaning: You are the greatest warrior with a body as strong as a thunderbolt. You destroy evil thoughts and are the companion of the wise.

verses.devanagari:
कंचन बरन बिराज सुबेसा ।
कानन कुंडल कुंचित केसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Kañcana Barana Birāja Subesā |
Kānana Kuṇḍala Kuñcita Kesā ||
verses.meaning: Your complexion has a golden glow and your appearance is beautiful with earrings and curly hair.

verses.devanagari:
हाथ बज्र औ ध्वजा बिराजै ।
काँधे मूँज जनेऊ साजै ॥
verses.transliteration:
Hātha Bajra Au Dhvajā Birājai |
Kāṃdhe Mūṃja Janeū Sājai ||
verses.meaning: You hold a thunderbolt and a flag in your hands. A sacred thread of munja grass adorns your shoulder.

verses.devanagari:
शंकर सुवन केसरीनंदन ।
तेज प्रताप महा जग बंदन ॥
verses.transliteration:
Śaṅkara Suvana Kesarīnandana |
Teja Pratāpa Mahā Jaga Bandana ||
verses.meaning: You are the incarnation of Lord Shiva and son of Kesari. The whole world sings the glories of your splendor.

verses.devanagari:
विद्यावान गुनी अति चातुर ।
राम काज करिबे को आतुर ॥
verses.transliteration:
Vidyāvāna Gunī Ati Cātura |
Rāma Kāja Karibe Ko Ātura ||
verses.meaning: You possess knowledge, great virtues, a sharp intellect, and are ever eager to serve Lord Rama.

verses.devanagari:
प्रभु चरित्र सुनिबे को रसिया ।
राम लखन सीता मन बसिया ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prabhu Charitra Sunibe Ko Rasiyā |
Rāma Lakhana Sītā Mana Basiyā ||
verses.meaning: You delight in listening to Lord Rama's deeds. Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita dwell in your heart.

verses.devanagari:
सूक्ष्म रूप धरि सियहिं दिखावा ।
बिकट रूप धरि लंक जरावा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sūkṣma Rūpa Dhari Siyahiṃ Dikhāvā |
Bikaṭa Rūpa Dhari Laṅka Jarāvā ||
verses.meaning: You assumed a minute form to appear before Sita, and a fierce form to burn Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
भीम रूप धरि असुर संहारे ।
रामचंद्र के काज सँवारे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhīma Rūpa Dhari Asura Saṃhāre |
Rāmacandra Ke Kāja Saṃvāre ||
verses.meaning: You took a gigantic form and slew many demons, accomplishing the mission of Lord Rama.

verses.devanagari:
लाय सजीवन लखन जियाये ।
श्रीरघुबीर हरषि उर लाये ॥
verses.transliteration:
Lāya Sajīvana Lakhana Jiyāye |
Śrī Raghubīra Haraṣi Ura Lāye ||
verses.meaning: You brought the Sanjivani herb and revived Lakshmana, bringing great joy to Lord Rama's heart.

verses.devanagari:
रघुपति कीन्हीं बहुत बड़ाई ।
तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई ॥
verses.transliteration:
Raghupati Kīnhīṃ Bahuta Baḍāī |
Tuma Mama Priya Bharatahi Sama Bhāī ||
verses.meaning: Lord Rama praised you greatly and said you are as dear to him as his brother Bharata.

verses.devanagari:
सहस बदन तुम्हरो जस गावैं ।
अस कहि श्रीपति कंठ लगावैं ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sahasa Badana Tumharo Jasa Gāvaiṃ |
Asa Kahi Śrīpati Kaṇṭha Lagāvaiṃ ||
verses.meaning: The thousand-headed Shesha sings your glories. Saying this, Lord Rama embraced you.

verses.devanagari:
सनकादिक ब्रह्मादि मुनीसा ।
नारद सारद सहित अहीसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sanakādika Brahmādi Munīsā |
Nārada Sārada Sahita Ahīsā ||
verses.meaning: Great sages like Sanaka, gods like Brahma, Narada, Sarasvati, and the serpent king sing your glories.

verses.devanagari:
जम कुबेर दिगपाल जहाँ ते ।
कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jama Kubera Digapāla Jahāṃ Te |
Kabi Kobida Kahi Sake Kahāṃ Te ||
verses.meaning: Yama, Kubera, the guardians of directions, poets, and scholars cannot fully describe your glory.

verses.devanagari:
तुम उपकार सुग्रीवहिं कीन्हा ।
राम मिलाय राज पद दीन्हा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tuma Upakāra Sugrīvahiṃ Kīnhā |
Rāma Milāya Rāja Pada Dīnhā ||
verses.meaning: You helped Sugriva by introducing him to Lord Rama, who restored his kingdom.

verses.devanagari:
तुम्हरो मंत्र बिभीषन माना ।
लंकेश्वर भए सब जग जाना ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tumharo Mantra Bibhīṣaṇa Mānā |
Laṅkeśvara Bhae Saba Jaga Jānā ||
verses.meaning: Vibhishana heeded your advice and became the renowned king of Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
जुग सहस्र जोजन पर भानू ।
लील्यो ताहि मधुर फल जानू ॥
verses.transliteration:
Juga Sahasra Jojana Para Bhānū |
Līlyo Tāhi Madhura Phala Jānū ||
verses.meaning: The sun, thousands of miles away, was swallowed by you as a child, thinking it a sweet fruit.

verses.devanagari:
प्रभु मुद्रिका मेलि मुख माहीं ।
जलधि लाँघि गये अचरज नाहीं ॥
verses.transliteration:
Prabhu Mudrikā Meli Mukha Māhīṃ |
Jaladhi Lāṃghi Gaye Acharaja Nāhīṃ ||
verses.meaning: With Lord Rama's ring in your mouth, you crossed the ocean — no surprise for one like you.

verses.devanagari:
दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते ।
सुगम अनुग्रह तुम्हरे तेते ॥
verses.transliteration:
Durgama Kāja Jagata Ke Jete |
Sugama Anugraha Tumhare Tete ||
verses.meaning: All difficult tasks of the world become easy by your grace.

verses.devanagari:
राम दुआरे तुम रखवारे ।
होत न आज्ञा बिनु पैसारे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Rāma Duāre Tuma Rakhavāre |
Hota Na Ājñā Binu Paisāre ||
verses.meaning: You guard the gateway to Rama's abode — none may enter without your permission.

verses.devanagari:
सब सुख लहै तुम्हारी सरना ।
तुम रक्षक काहू को डर ना ॥
verses.transliteration:
Saba Sukha Lahai Tumhārī Saranā |
Tuma Rakṣaka Kāhū Ko Ḍara Nā ||
verses.meaning: All joys are found in your refuge. With you as protector, there is nothing to fear.

verses.devanagari:
आपन तेज सम्हारो आपै ।
तीनों लोक हाँक तें काँपै ॥
verses.transliteration:
Āpana Teja Samhāro Āpai |
Tīnoṃ Loka Hāṃka Teṃ Kāṃpai ||
verses.meaning: You alone can control your own blazing splendor. The three worlds tremble at your roar.

verses.devanagari:
भूत पिसाच निकट नहिं आवै ।
महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै ॥
verses.transliteration:
Bhūta Pisāca Nikaṭa Nahiṃ Āvai |
Mahābīra Jaba Nāma Sunāvai ||
verses.meaning: Ghosts and demons dare not come near when the name of Mahavira is chanted.

verses.devanagari:
नासै रोग हरै सब पीरा ।
जपत निरंतर हनुमत बीरा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Nāsai Roga Harai Saba Pīrā |
Japata Nirantara Hanumata Bīrā ||
verses.meaning: All ailments and pain are destroyed by constantly chanting the name of the brave Hanuman.

verses.devanagari:
संकट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै ।
मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै ॥
verses.transliteration:
Saṅkaṭa Teṃ Hanumāna Chuḍāvai |
Mana Krama Bachana Dhyāna Jo Lāvai ||
verses.meaning: Hanuman frees from all troubles those who meditate on him in thought, deed, and speech.

verses.devanagari:
सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा ।
तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Saba Para Rāma Tapasvī Rājā |
Tina Ke Kāja Sakala Tuma Sājā ||
verses.meaning: Lord Rama is the supreme ascetic king, and you carry out all his missions.

verses.devanagari:
और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै ।
सोई अमित जीवन फल पावै ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aura Manoratha Jo Koī Lāvai |
Soī Amita Jīvana Phala Pāvai ||
verses.meaning: Whoever brings a desire to you receives the limitless fruit of life.

verses.devanagari:
चारों जुग परताप तुम्हारा ।
है परसिद्ध जगत उजियारा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Cāroṃ Juga Paratāpa Tumhārā |
Hai Parasiddha Jagata Ujiyārā ||
verses.meaning: Your glory is renowned in the four ages, and its radiance shines across the world.

verses.devanagari:
साधु संत के तुम रखवारे ।
असुर निकंदन राम दुलारे ॥
verses.transliteration:
Sādhu Santa Ke Tuma Rakhavāre |
Asura Nikandana Rāma Dulāre ||
verses.meaning: You are the protector of the righteous, destroyer of demons, and beloved of Lord Rama.

verses.devanagari:
अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता ।
अस बर दीन जानकी माता ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aṣṭa Siddhi Nau Nidhi Ke Dātā |
Asa Bara Dīna Jānakī Mātā ||
verses.meaning: Mother Sita granted you the boon of bestowing eight siddhis and nine forms of wealth.

verses.devanagari:
राम रसायन तुम्हरे पासा ।
सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Rāma Rasāyana Tumhare Pāsā |
Sadā Raho Raghupati Ke Dāsā ||
verses.meaning: You possess the elixir of devotion to Lord Rama and remain ever his devoted servant.

verses.devanagari:
तुम्हरे भजन राम को पावै ।
जनम जनम के दुख बिसरावै ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tumhare Bhajana Rāma Ko Pāvai |
Janama Janama Ke Dukha Bisarāvai ||
verses.meaning: Through your worship one attains Lord Rama and forgets the sorrows of countless births.

verses.devanagari:
अंत काल रघुबर पुर जाई ।
जहाँ जन्म हरिभक्त कहाई ॥
verses.transliteration:
Anta Kāla Raghubara Pura Jāī |
Jahāṃ Janma Haribhakta Kahāī ||
verses.meaning: At the end of life one goes to Rama's abode, and wherever born, is known as a devotee.

verses.devanagari:
और देवता चित्त न धरई ।
हनुमत सेई सर्ब सुख करई ॥
verses.transliteration:
Aura Devatā Citta Na Dharaī |
Hanumata Seī Sarba Sukha Karaī ||
verses.meaning: One who worships Hanuman with single-pointed devotion enjoys all bliss.

verses.devanagari:
संकट कटै मिटै सब पीरा ।
जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Saṅkaṭa Kaṭai Miṭai Saba Pīrā |
Jo Sumirai Hanumata Balabīrā ||
verses.meaning: All difficulties and pain are destroyed for one who remembers the mighty Hanuman.

verses.devanagari:
जय जय जय हनुमान गोसाईं ।
कृपा करहु गुरुदेव की नाईं ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hanumāna Gosāīṃ |
Kṛpā Karahu Gurudeva Kī Nāīṃ ||
verses.meaning: Glory, glory, all glory to Lord Hanuman. Please shower your grace as a guru would.

verses.devanagari:
जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई ।
छूटहि बंदि महा सुख होई ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jo Sata Bāra Pāṭha Kara Koī |
Chūṭahi Bandi Mahā Sukha Hoī ||
verses.meaning: One who recites this a hundred times is freed from bondage and enjoys supreme bliss.

verses.devanagari:
जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चलीसा ।
होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Jo Yaha Paḍhai Hanumāna Chalīsā |
Hoya Siddhi Sākhī Gaurīsā ||
verses.meaning: Lord Shiva bears witness that one who recites this Hanuman Chalisa attains perfection.

verses.devanagari:
तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा ।
कीजै नाथ हृदय महँ डेरा ॥
verses.transliteration:
Tulasīdāsa Sadā Hari Cherā |
Kījai Nātha Hṛdaya Mahaṃ Ḍerā ||
verses.meaning: Tulasidas, ever a servant of the Lord, prays: O Lord, please take up residence in my heart.

verses.devanagari:
पवनतनय संकट हरन मंगल मूरति रूप ।
राम लखन सीता सहित हृदय बसहु सुर भूप ॥
verses.transliteration:
Pavanatanaya Saṅkaṭa Harana, Maṅgala Mūrati Rūpa |
Rāma Lakhana Sītā Sahita, Hṛdaya Basahu Sura Bhūpa ||
verses.meaning: O Hanuman, destroyer of all miseries and embodiment of auspiciousness. O king of the gods, please dwell in my heart along with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita.
